name: Heroes Convention
blurb: A creator-focused, comics-first convention in Charlotte founded in 1982, known for an artist-driven guest list and a family-friendly atmosphere.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'HEROES CONVENTION JUNE 11-13, 2027 Charlotte Convention Center 501 S. College St. Charlotte, NC 28202'; 'Who will we bring in for our 45th Anniversary Show?! WHO KNOWS?! STAY TUNED!'

notes: The Featured Guest List page is still titled '2026 FEATURED GUEST LIST' with a 2026 header image, and the homepage itself says the 45th-anniversary (2027) guest list is not yet known ('WHO KNOWS?! STAY TUNED!'), so 2027 guests are treated as not-yet-announced rather than reusing the 2026 names.
